consumables.name: Gun Crew Assistance
consumables.description:
This consumable can reinforce an allied ship. Using it on your own ship significantly reduces the consumable efficiency.

If several consumables are used on the same ship and their modifiers coincide by type but differ by value, only the higher values are applied. Using a consumable with identical modifiers and values on the same ship resets the consumable action timer.

Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy acoustic torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Short-Burst Smoke Generator
consumables.description:
Generates a smoke screen that reduces the risk of being detected by the enemy.

Numerous charges and high reload speed; short action and smoke dispersion times.

consumables.name: Engine Boost
consumables.description: Increases ship's maximum speed.

consumables.name: Short-Range Hydroacoustic Search
consumables.description:
Increases the range of assured acquisition of enemy ships and torpedoes, including those within smoke screens.

Extended action time; short acquisition range of ships.

consumables.name: Gun Crew Assistance
consumables.description:
This consumable can reinforce an allied ship. Using it on your own ship significantly reduces the consumable efficiency.

If several consumables are used on the same ship and their modifiers coincide by type but differ by value, only the higher values are applied. Using a consumable with identical modifiers and values on the same ship resets the consumable action timer.
